config:
model = "fixture-v2"
model_catalog_json = "$ROOT/codex-home/fixture-models.json"
approval_policy = "never"
sandbox_mode = "danger-full-access"
model_provider = "fixture"
check_for_update_on_startup = false
suppress_unstable_features_warning = true

[features]
hooks = true
multi_agent = true
plugins = false
apps = false

[analytics]
enabled = false

[model_providers.fixture]
name = "Fixture"
base_url = "http://127.0.0.1:35869/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
request_max_retries = 0
stream_max_retries = 0

[projects."$ROOT/repository"]
trust_level = "trusted"
